item.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula, EMSC says
item.description: USGS recorded a magnitude 6.9 earthquake, 76 km NE of Ozernovskiy, Russia. [Confirmado] Fuentes: USGS (earthquakes), Reuters

item.title: Hurricane Trudy strengthens off Mexico’s coast with major storm expected
item.description: The Pacific Ocean is seeing more storms, and stronger storms, than usual. Here’s what’s going on (and how it all traces back to El Niño). [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, The New York Times

item.title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
item.description: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress,… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: Second Ebola Infection Announced in Kenya
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) continues to support Kenya’s efforts to contain Ebola after a second person tested positive for the Bundibugyo virus, the UN agency’s representative in the country said on Thursday. [Confirmado] Fuentes: UN News, The New York Times

item.title: Pennsylvania man who killed family had controlled their movements and finances: police
item.description: The Pennsylvania man accused of killing eight people "exercised significant control" over his family at their Erie home, police said. [Probable] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, CBS News

item.title: Giant Bicycle retira del mercado las llaves con luz LED incluidas en los juegos de candados para bicicleta SureLock debido al riesgo de lesiones graves o muerte por ingestión de baterías; viola la norma obligatoria para productos de consumo con baterías de botón
item.description: La llave con luz LED que se incluyó con ciertos juegos de candados para bicicleta SureLock viola la norma de seguridad obligatoria para productos de consumo con baterías de botón y de moneda, ya que los niños pueden acceder fácilmente a… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission
